description: Verify the self-contained integrity, wallet authorization, and collector signature of one supplied AIPOU receipt. Host execution, delivery, and external effect remain UNKNOWN in this receipt-only check. The tool does not establish collector trust, business acceptance, or settlement, query a registry, or submit a claim.

receipt.description: A receipt object containing hashes and signatures only. Do not include raw prompts, outputs, private keys, or customer data.

name: verify_aipou_receipt
